summary: Requirements cover the request (count lines/words/chars via python -m textcli count). All acceptance-criteria counts were recomputed by hand and are correct, including the fixed AC-001-3 (1 2 6) and new AC-001-4 (1 0 1). Empty-file and missing-file behaviour are specified, and assumptions are recorded.

checklist.note: lines, words, chars, CLI form covered by REQ-001..003
counting rules defined precisely (newline handling, str.split, chars incl. newlines)
16/5/6/1 chars and line/word counts verified by hand
ASM-001..003 cover CRLF, invalid input, usage errors

findings.description: Behaviour for invalid UTF-8, directories and unreadable files is explicitly out of scope (ASM-002); acceptable for this scope.
REQ-004 has no acceptance criteria; it is a constraint and can be checked by review.
